line.a_pociag.text: Choo-choo! This is my train. Today it goes through the forest to the lake!

line.a_chce.text: I want to ride! And Owl too!

line.a_bilet.text: First you need a ticket. A ticket costs as many coins as its number shows.

line.a_cztery.text: Your ticket, Bear, costs four coins. Look, this is what the number four looks like.

line.a_zaplac.text: Help Bear pay. Drag four coins onto the plate.

line.a_cztery_monety.text: One, two, three, four. Four coins, just right!

line.a_napisz.text: Write a four on Bear's ticket. Run your finger from the green dot.

line.a_moj_bilet.text: My ticket with a four! I'm going!

line.b_wagony.text: My train has five wagons. Each has its number: one, two, three, four, five.

line.b_bilet2.text: Mouse has a ticket with the number two. Which wagon does she get into? Point to it.

line.b_bilet5.text: Bunny has a ticket with the number five. Which wagon is it? Point to it.

line.b_bilet3.text: Hedgehog has a ticket with the number three. Which wagon is it? Point to it.

line.zly_wagon.text: Not that wagon. Look at the number on the ticket.

line.b_wsiada.text: All aboard! Have a good trip!

line.b_odjazd.text: Everyone in their seats? Off we go!

line.c_jablka.text: A stop in the forest! Bear picked apples and I picked pears.

line.c_wiecej.text: I have more! Look how long my row is!

line.c_policz.text: A long row isn't more yet. Let's count. Touch Bear's apples one by one.

line.c_piec_misia.text: Five apples. Now count my pears.

line.c_tyle_samo.text: Five too! Five and five are the same, even when they lie far apart.

line.c_rozumiem.text: I see! My row was longer, but there weren't more apples.

line.c_cyfra5.text: And this is what the number five looks like.

line.c_dzwonek.text: Listen to my bell and count how many times it rings.

line.c_ile_dzwonkow.text: How many times did the bell ring? Point to the number.

line.d_jezioro.text: The lake! End of the trip, everybody off!

line.d_ilu.text: How many passengers came? Count them, touching each one.

line.p_start.text: Let's practise numbers up to five! I have five games.

line.p_ile.text: How many are there? Count and point to the number.

line.p_bilet5.text: This ticket costs five coins. Drag five coins onto the plate.

line.p_napisz5.text: Write a five with your finger. Start at the green dot.

line.p_cztery.text: Where are four apples? Point to them.

line.p_cztery_nie.text: Count the apples again. We're looking for four.

line.p_kamienie.text: I want to hop to the stone with the number four. Which one is it? Point to it.

line.p_kamienie_nie.text: That's not four. Look at the numbers under the stones.

line.p_doskoczylem.text: One, two, three, four! I'm on the four!

line.h_jutro.text: Tomorrow we ride the train again. The backpack needs packing.

line.h_spakuj.text: Put five things in the backpack. Drag them one at a time and I'll count.

line.h_za_duzo.text: That's five already! The backpack is full.

line.h_spakowane.text: Five things in the backpack. Ready!

line.h_palce.text: How many fingers does this hand have? Count and point to the number.

line.h_palce_nie.text: Count the fingers again, one by one.

line.h_piec_palcow.text: Five fingers! You have five fingers on each hand.

line.h_rodzice.text: Count to five with your parents: five stairs, five spoons, five claps!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for riding with me! Here is a sticker for your album. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is a wagon from Mole's train. We got it when we counted to five.
